title: Every meter carries the ladder's Space, Business and Collective numbers and the Crew host kit numbers
detail:
PHASE 2 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. meter-limits.ts gains a collective column on every plan-axis row and allowanceAt reads it (Non Profit Collective reads Collective; Non Profit and Independent read Business). Numbers per the ladder tables, including the Crew host kit (5 Circles, 10 Events, 5 Journeys, 50 people) which is unlimited today. A table-driven test asserts every number per tier.

Every meter reads the five-tier ladder numbers; collective rung on every plan-axis row; table-driven test in lib/pricing/ladder-limits.test.ts

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const lim=(()=>{const s=r("lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts");const a=s.indexOf("PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS");const b=s.indexOf("= {",a);const e=s.indexOf("\n}\n",b);return Function("return "+s.slice(b+2,e+2).replace(/\/\/.*$/gm,"").replace(/(\d)_(\d)/g,"$1$2"))()})();const want=(k,t,v)=>{const row=lim[k];if(!row)fail(k+" is not a meter yet");if(!(t in row)||row[t]!==v)fail(k+"."+t+" is "+JSON.stringify(row[t])+", the ladder says "+JSON.stringify(v))};want("space_crm","free",250);want("space_crm","business",5000);want("space_crm","collective",25000);want("space_email","free",1000);want("space_email","collective",100000);want("space_automation","free",100);want("space_automation","business",2000);want("space_automation","collective",10000);want("space_qr","free",5);want("space_team","collective",5);want("space_vera","collective",null);want("space_journey","free",25);want("space_bookings","free",20);want("space_membership_tiers","business",5);want("space_collaborators","free",0);want("space_collaborators","business",3);want("space_multi_pipeline","business",5);want("space_crm_resonance_ai","collective",10000);want("circle_host","crew",5);want("event_create","crew",10);want("journey_publish","crew",5);want("journey_enrollees","crew",50);if(!/collective/.test(r("lib/pricing/feature-meters.ts").split("export function allowanceAt")[1]||""))fail("allowanceAt never reads a collective column");console.log("ok: every meter reads the ladder numbers")'
